items.summary: Maruti Suzuki reported production volume for October 2026, totaling 260,003 vehicles.
Maruti Suzuki achieved record sales of 276,120 units in October 2026, highest monthly sales ever.
Maruti Suzuki crossed 50,000 EV exports, leading India's EV exports in passenger vehicles.
Maruti Suzuki informed about a copy of newspaper publication.
Audio recording of investors' call on financial results for Q2 FY 2026-27 uploaded.
Maruti Suzuki informed about an investor presentation.
Maruti Suzuki's board approved financial results for Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27.
Maruti Suzuki submitted financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki informed about the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary.
Maruti Suzuki launched VICTORIS AURUM Edition to celebrate record sales success.
